v47_session.description: Starts the v47 session and binds the caller as its operator, so ${operator.name} and fixture placeholders resolve and the panel goes to the caller. Run once per world after v42_world_prepare, and again after the hint cards (they stop the session). Expect V47_SESSION_READY.

v47_scene.description: The scene every v47 card uses, in any overworld, at fixed coordinates (rerunnable: a fill or setblock that changes nothing is tolerated). A stone floor at y 99, x -6 to 6, z -4 to 16, with air above to y 107 and no light source on it (sky light only; noon, daylight cycle off); the caller in creative at 0.5 100 0.5 facing south (yaw 0) with an empty inventory and no effects. Fixtures, each tagged v47_fx: a zombie v47zombie (no AI, unbreakable helmet, so it neither moves nor burns) at -2.5 100 5.5, 5.8 blocks away; a saddled pig v47mount (no AI) at 3.5 100 0.5, 3 blocks east; a chest at -3 100 2 facing east holding stone 64 in slot 0, dirt 10 in slot 1, iron ingot 5 in slot 2 and a diamond sword named 'v47 sword' with the lore 'v47 lore line' in slot 3. The caller is moved first and the build waits for the chunks. Expect AWAIT outcome=satisfied, BLOCK_INSPECT minecraft:chest at -3 100 2, four INVENTORY_INSPECT records for the chest, ASSERT pass for one zombie and one pig, and V47_SCENE_READY.
commands: setblock -3 100 2 minecraft:chest 5 replace {Items:[{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:stone",Count:64b},{Slot:1b,id:"minecraft:dirt",Count:10b},{Slot:2b,id:"minecraft:iron_ingot",Count:5b},{Slot:3b,id:"minecraft:diamond_sword",Count:1b,tag:{display:{Name:"v47 sword",Lore:["v47 lore line"]}}}]}

commands.command: devtool assert entities count 1 within 32 type minecraft:zombie name v47zombie

commands: devtool assert entities count 1 within 32 type minecraft:pig name v47mount

v47_reset_pos.description: Puts the caller back at the scene start, 0.5 100 0.5 facing south, creative, empty hands, no open screen. Run between cards. Expect V47_POS_READY.

v47_toast_shots.description: hide=toasts (1.9.0). Run first in a new survival world whose options.txt has tutorialStep:movement, so the tutorial's hint toast shows; the tutorial shows that hint only after 100 ticks in the world, so the bundle waits 100 ticks after its first mark before anything else. It also grants Stone Age, whose advancement toast shows for about 5 seconds. Pictures: v47_toast_plain (hide=chat: the toasts in the top right corner), v47_toast_hidden 2 ticks later (hide=chat,toasts: no toast), v47_toast_back 10 ticks later (hide=chat: the toasts back, same order). Expect SCREENSHOT records hide=chat, hide=chat,toasts, hide=chat, no hideFailed, and V47_TOASTS_END.

v47_keys.description: Key bindings by name (1.9.0). client keys key. lists the vanilla bindings (expect KEY_BINDING binding=key.jump key=SPACE and CLIENT_ACTION step=keys result=done listed truncated=false); client key key.nothing press is refused by the client (expect CLIENT_ACTION result=refused reason=unknownKey, nothing pressed). Ends with V47_KEYS_END.

v47_walk.description: A held key walks (1.9.0). From the scene start facing south: PLAYER_INSPECT, client key key.forward hold 40, PLAYER_INSPECT 60 ticks later. Expect CLIENT_ACTION step=key binding=key.forward route=binding result=started, then result=done heldTicks=40 released=done with pressedTick and releasedTick; the second position about 8 to 9 blocks further south (posZ larger) on the same x. Ends with V47_WALK_END.

v47_jump_raw.description: A raw key (1.9.0). From the scene start: client key key.jump hold 20 raw=true. On the development client expect route=binding+raw (the toolkit wrote the key into LWJGL's state and read it back through Keyboard.isKeyDown before trusting it), started then done heldTicks=20 released=done, and a PLAYER_INSPECT 6 ticks in with posY above 100; on Cleanroom the same, or result=refused reason=routeUnavailable with detail. Ends with V47_JUMP_END.

commands.command: devtool client key key.jump hold 20 raw=true

v47_queue_keys.description: Vanilla keys through the keyboard queue (1.9.0; base profile on Cleanroom and the development client). From the scene start facing south: PLAYER_INSPECT, client key key.forward hold 40 route=queue, PLAYER_INSPECT 60 ticks later. Expect CLIENT_ACTION step=key binding=key.forward route=queue result=started with pressedTick (written at the tick start its key-down went into the queue, not when asked), then result=done heldTicks=40 released=done with releasedTick; the second position about 8 to 9 blocks further south on the same x, as v47_walk. Then client key key.inventory press route=queue, a binding no mod listens to: expect route=queue result=done with pressedTick and releasedTick, and client screen showing the creative inventory (SCREEN_INFO screen=net.minecraft.client.gui.inventory.GuiContainerCreative), opened by the game from the queued key; then client close. On Cleanroom a refusal routeUnavailable with detail is recorded as it stands. Ends with V47_QUEUE_KEYS_END.
commands: devtool client key key.forward hold 40 route=queue

commands.command: devtool client key key.inventory press route=queue

v47_mount.description: Sneak dismounts (1.9.0). Faces the saddled pig v47mount 3 blocks east, right-clicks it with an empty hand (the player rides it), moves the pig 3 blocks south with the player on it, then client key key.sneak hold 20, and puts the pig back. A pig's NBT never lists a player passenger (a player is saved apart from the entity it rides), so riding is read from the player's position: a seated player stands about 0.33 above the floor, where the pig is. Expect CLIENT_ACTION step=face done with aimX near 3.5, step=use target=entity entityType=minecraft:pig; PLAYER_INSPECT before the use at x 0.5 z 0.5 y 100.0; while riding at x near 3.5, z near 0.5, y near 100.33; after the pig moved, at z near 3.5 (the player moved with it), y near 100.33; step=key binding=key.sneak done heldTicks=20; after the sneak at y 100.0 on the floor (no longer seated) and no longer following the pig when it goes back. Ends with V47_MOUNT_END.

v47_two_holds.description: Two holds at once (1.9.0). client key key.forward hold 60, then 10 ticks later client key key.sneak hold 30 keepHold=true. Expect both started; sneak done heldTicks=30 released=done; forward done heldTicks=60 released=done (not nextAction); a position change southward. Ends with V47_TWO_HOLDS_END.

commands.command: devtool client key key.sneak hold 30 keepHold=true

v47_hold_keep.description: A press while a hold runs (1.9.0). A shield in hotbar slot 0, selected; client hold use 60 (the shield is raised, a hand is active), then 20 ticks later client attack keepHold=true. Expect the use hold started, then done heldTicks=60 released=done; the attack's record with route=binding and taken (false expected: vanilla drains a press while a hand is active). Ends with V47_HOLD_KEEP_END.

v47_hold_next.description: The same without keepHold (1.9.0). client hold use 60, then 20 ticks later client attack. Expect the use hold done released=nextAction with heldTicks about 20, then the attack's record. Ends with V47_HOLD_NEXT_END.

v47_look.description: Turning (1.9.0). client look 90 0, then the server's NBT of the player (expect Rotation:[90.0f,0.0f]: west, as the server holds it); client look 0 0 over=20 (expect started over=20, then done turnTicks=20 endYaw=0); client look 179 0, then client look -179 0 over=10 (the short way, 2 degrees across 180: expect endYaw=-179 and a small turn); NBT again. Ends with V47_LOOK_END.

v47_face_attack.description: Facing a target, then attacking in the same tick (1.9.0). The caller is moved to 0.5 100 5.5 facing south (yaw 0), so the zombie (-2.5 100 5.5) stands 3 blocks to its west, at its side: face must turn the view about 90 degrees before the attack can hit (in open air vanilla limits the entity pick to the block ray's reach, 5.0 even in creative, and the zombie seen from the scene start, 5.8 blocks, is past it). client face @e[type=minecraft:zombie,c=1] (the one zombie) and client attack. Expect the server's action=requested step=face target=entity entityType=minecraft:zombie; the client's face done with startYaw about 0 and endYaw about 90, aimX/aimY/aimZ near -2.5/101.7/5.5; the attack's target=entity entityType=minecraft:zombie; ENTITY_DAMAGE on v47zombie. Then client face block 3000 100 3000 (not loaded): refused at once, tolerated devtool.client.noTarget, CLIENT_ACTION action=refused reason=noTarget. Ends with V47_FACE_END. The first attack waits 21 ticks after the teleport: a teleport to the spot the client last reported leaves the server reading the caller as in the air for up to 20 ticks, which changes an attack (no sweep, no critical hit).

v47_view.description: The camera view (1.9.0). client view back, then a picture v47_view_back (hide=chat,toasts: the player seen from behind), then client view first. Expect CLIENT_ACTION step=view view=back viewWas=first, then view=first viewWas=back. Ends with V47_VIEW_END.

v47_view_front.description: The camera view from the front (1.9.0), in one bundle so the picture is taken before the view goes back. client view front, then a picture v47_view_front (hide=chat,toasts: the player's face), then client view first. Expect CLIENT_ACTION step=view view=front viewWas=first, the SCREENSHOT saved record for v47_view_front before the step=view view=first viewWas=front record. Ends with V47_VIEW_FRONT_END.

v47_focus_walk.description: Emulated focus loss during a walk (1.9.0). client key key.forward hold 100, client focus lost 20 ticks in, PLAYER_INSPECT 5 and 45 ticks after (the walk stopped: the second reading may be a few hundredths of a block further, 0.04 on the campaign's runs, since the player still glides a little after the key is let go and the client sends its position only after a move of more than about 0.03 blocks; a walk that went on would be blocks further), client focus gained. Expect the hold done released=focusLost (not nextAction) before 100 ticks; focus lost emulated=true windowChanged=false, showing=none when the client's pause on lost focus is off and showing=net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiIngameMenu when it is on; focus gained done, or refused noRealFocus when the real window had no focus. With the pause on and the real window without focus, the game itself keeps the pause menu open (it reopens it every frame), so the hold is refused screenOpen and the focus lost record's screen already names the pause menu: recorded as it stands. Until the game takes focus back, later queued keys and clicks are refused noFocus, so run it after the cards that queue input or right before a leave of the world. Ends with V47_FOCUS_END.

v47_keyup_glide.description: The comparison for v47_focus_walk's small further reading (1.9.0): a walk ended by a plain key-up, with no focus loss. client key key.forward hold 40 (the binding route; it ends by itself), PLAYER_INSPECT 45 ticks after the request (about 5 ticks after the release) and 40 ticks after that (about 45 after the release), the same spacing as v47_focus_walk's two readings after the loss. Expect the hold done released=done heldTicks=40; the two readings' posZ differ by no more than a few hundredths of a block (v47_focus_walk read 4.77 then 4.81). The release tick is read from the hold's own record and compared with the readings' worldTick. Ends with V47_KEYUP_END.

v47_routes.description: Click routes (1.9.0). The caller is moved to 0.5 100 5.5 facing south (yaw 0), 3 blocks from the zombie at its west side (as v47_face_attack: past about 5 blocks in open air the entity pick misses), so face must turn about 90 degrees: expect the face record's startYaw about 0 and endYaw about 90. Faces the zombie and attacks three times, 25 ticks apart (past its hurt immunity): route=binding (as 1.8.0), route=event (also Forge's MouseInputEvent), route=queue (a real button press in the mouse queue; on Cleanroom done or refused routeUnavailable). Expect three attack records with route=binding, route=event, route=queue and target=entity, and ENTITY_DAMAGE for each click that reached the game. Ends with V47_ROUTES_END. The first attack waits 21 ticks after the teleport: a teleport to the spot the client last reported leaves the server reading the caller as in the air for up to 20 ticks, which changes an attack (no sweep, no critical hit).

v47_chest_open.description: Opens the scene chest (1.9.0): refills it with the known items, empties the caller's inventory, faces the chest block and right-clicks it, then client screen. Expect CLIENT_ACTION step=use target=block targetBlock=minecraft:chest; SCREEN_INFO screen=net.minecraft.client.gui.inventory.GuiChest container=true slots=63 listed=buttons,slots; SCREEN_SLOT slot=0 item=minecraft:stone count=64, slot=1 dirt 10, slot=2 iron_ingot 5, slot=3 diamond_sword 1. The chest stays open for the click lines that follow. Ends with V47_CHEST_OPEN.
commands: setblock -3 100 2 minecraft:chest 5 replace {Items:[{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:stone",Count:64b},{Slot:1b,id:"minecraft:dirt",Count:10b},{Slot:2b,id:"minecraft:iron_ingot",Count:5b},{Slot:3b,id:"minecraft:diamond_sword",Count:1b,tag:{display:{Name:"v47 sword",Lore:["v47 lore line"]}}}]}

v47_chest_check.description: Reads what the server kept after the chest clicks: the chest's slots and the caller's inventory. After the card's lines (slot 0 shift, slot 1 left twice, slot 2 right then left, slot 2 key=1) expect the chest with dirt 10 in slot 1 and the sword in slot 3 only, and the inventory with iron_ingot 5 in slot 0 and stone 64 in slot 8 (a shift click from a chest fills the player's slots from the end). Ends with V47_CHEST_CHECKED.

v47_creative_open.description: Opens the creative inventory for the container tooltip card (1.9.0): no effects (so the screen is not shifted), then client inventory and client screen. Expect showing=net.minecraft.client.gui.inventory.GuiContainerCreative and SCREEN_INFO with width and height (854x480 window at gui scale 2: width=427 height=240). Ends with V47_CREATIVE_OPEN.

v47_quiet_tp.description: Fifteen teleports on the scene floor (z 0.5 to 7.5). No quiet key on purpose: the card checks the run's default (an inbox run is quiet, a console or typed run is not) and the word quiet=false. Quiet: no [CHAT] Teleported line in the client log between BUNDLE_START and BUNDLE_END, the server's own [Developer: Teleported ...] lines still there (logAdminCommands on), BUNDLE_END quiet=true chatSuppressed>=15. Loud: fifteen [CHAT] Teleported lines, quiet=false chatSuppressed=0. Ends with V47_QUIET_TP_END (its own reply also suppressed when quiet).

v47_quiet_fail.description: A quiet run whose third command (index 2) fails. quiet true in the file. Expect outcome failed, BUNDLE_END quiet=true failed=1 stoppedEarly=true, and exactly one chat line: [DevToolkit] Bundle 'v47_quiet_fail' command 2 failed: devtool.assert.failed; no Teleported line.
commands: devtool assert entities count 99 within 2 type minecraft:pig

v47_quiet_nested.description: Nested quiet runs. quiet true in the file; runs v47_nested_child (no quiet key: follows its parent, quiet) and v47_nested_loud (quiet false in its file: loud). Expect BUNDLE_START bundle=v47_nested_child quiet=true and bundle=v47_nested_loud quiet=false, one [CHAT] Teleported line (from the loud child only), and V47_NESTED_END.

v47_nested_child.description: Child of v47_quiet_nested with no quiet key: follows its parent. One teleport.

v47_nested_loud.description: Child of v47_quiet_nested with quiet false in its file: loud even inside a quiet parent. One teleport.

v47_console_tp_loud.description: Console run with no quiet key on purpose: the card checks that a run not started by the inbox is loud by default. For the isolated server with one client connected as an operator. Fifteen teleports of the nearest player: the client, an operator other than the sender, sees fifteen grey [Server: Teleported ...] lines in its log ([CHAT]). Expect BUNDLE_END channel=console quiet=false chatSuppressed=0 failed=0.

v47_console_tp_quiet.description: Console run, quiet (quiet true in the file), as v47_console_tp_loud. Expect no new [Server: Teleported line in the client's log, the server console still logging the teleports, and BUNDLE_END channel=console quiet=true chatSuppressed>=15 failed=0.

v47_console_platform.description: Console run on the isolated server: moves the one player (@p) into the test area first, since the isolated flat world spawns it far from 0 0 and only a player loads chunks, waits for the chunks there, builds the scene floor at y 99 so the console teleports land on stone, and puts the player on it at 0.5 100 0.5. Quiet (quiet true in the file), so its own teleports send no [Server: Teleported line to the operator client before the loud console run the card counts. Expect AWAIT outcome=satisfied and V47_CONSOLE_PLATFORM.

v47_panel_cue.description: The prompt panel with a quiet run (1.9.0), quiet true in the file. Fifteen teleports (nested v47_quiet_tp, quiet by inheritance), a cue V47_PANEL_READ panel sound (its sound, block.note.pling, has no subtitle in 1.12.2, so no subtitle shows even with subtitles on; the panel beside a subtitle is v47_panel_subtitle), picture v47_panel_cue 20 ticks later (hide=toasts: expect the panel on the right with the label, no chat line over it or near it, below any potion icons, no subtitle), then checkpoint ack (answered=cue) and picture v47_panel_after_ack (expect no panel). CHECKPOINT action=cue form=panel. Ends with V47_PANEL_CUE_END.
commands: devtool checkpoint cue V47_PANEL_READ panel sound

v47_panel_subtitle.description: The panel and a subtitle together (1.9.0), quiet true; for a client with subtitles on (options.txt showSubtitles:true). The cue's own sound (block.note.pling) has no subtitle in 1.12.2's sounds.json, so a note block harp sound, which has one ('Note Block plays'), is played to the caller right after a cue V47_PANEL_SUB panel sound. Picture v47_panel_subtitle 10 ticks later (hide=toasts: expect the panel on the right and the subtitle at the bottom right, the panel above it, not over it). Then ack. Ends with V47_PANEL_SUB_END.
commands: devtool checkpoint cue V47_PANEL_SUB panel sound

v47_panel_f1.description: The panel and F1 (1.9.0), quiet true; for a development client whose run/options.txt puts the spectator outline binding on F1 for this launch only (key_key.spectatorOutlines:59; no other binding is on F1, and the binding does nothing outside spectator mode). A cue V47_PANEL_F1 panel; picture v47_panel_f1_shown 10 ticks later (no hide: the panel and the HUD); then client key key.spectatorOutlines press route=queue, so the keyboard queue carries a real F1 key-down that the game reads with no screen open and toggles its own hide-GUI setting, as a person's F1 does; picture v47_panel_f1_hidden 5 ticks after the press (expect no panel, no hotbar, no crosshair, no hand); the same press again; picture v47_panel_f1_back 5 ticks later (the HUD and the panel back). Expect each press's record step=key result=done binding=key.spectatorOutlines keyCode=59 route=queue with pressedTick and releasedTick, and the three SCREENSHOT ... action=saved records. Then ack. Ends with V47_PANEL_F1_END.

commands.command: devtool client key key.spectatorOutlines press route=queue
devtool client key key.spectatorOutlines press route=queue

v47_panel_stack.description: The panel below potion icons and toasts (1.9.0), quiet true. Speed and jump boost with their particles shown (the game draws an effect's icon at the top right only when its particles are shown), the Getting an Upgrade advancement (a toast top right for about 5 seconds), a cue V47_PANEL_STACK. Picture v47_panel_stack 10 ticks later (hide=chat: the panel below the two icons and below the toasts, or below the icons with a toast over it when no room is left) and v47_panel_stack_later 140 ticks later (the advancement toast gone; the panel moved up below the icons, or below a tutorial toast that is still showing: client look does not move the tutorial on, so in a world where the tutorial's look hint shows, that toast stays). Then ack and the effects cleared. Ends with V47_PANEL_STACK_END.

v47_sidebar.description: The panel beside a scoreboard sidebar (1.9.0), quiet true. A sidebar objective v47side with 5 lines, a cue V47_PANEL_SIDEBAR, picture v47_panel_sidebar5 (hide=chat,toasts: the panel above or below the sidebar, never over it); the ten more lines are set only 20 ticks after that picture's request (set in the same tick, they reached the client before the picture was taken, which then showed 15 lines); then 15 lines, picture v47_panel_sidebar15 (the panel above, below or beside it, never over it). Then ack and the objective removed. Ends with V47_SIDEBAR_END.

commands.command: scoreboard objectives add v47side dummy V47 Side

v47_panel_hud.description: F1 and hide=hud hide the panel (1.9.0), quiet true. A cue V47_PANEL_HUD, picture v47_panel_nohud (hide=hud: no panel, no hotbar, no hand) and v47_panel_withhud 5 ticks later (hide=chat,toasts: the panel back). Then ack. Ends with V47_PANEL_HUD_END.

v47_panel_arm_timeout.description: An armed checkpoint's panel and its timeout (1.9.0), quiet true. A picture is asked for 40 ticks ahead, then arm V47_ARM_TIMEOUT 100 (tolerated devtool.wait.timeout). Expect CHECKPOINT action=arm form=panel timeoutTicks=100; v47_panel_arm showing the label and 'Type /devtool checkpoint ack'; AWAIT condition=checkpoint outcome=timedOut; v47_panel_arm_gone 20 ticks after it with no panel. Ends with V47_ARM_TIMEOUT_END.

v47_panel_arm_wait.description: An armed checkpoint answered by an acknowledgement (1.9.0), quiet true. Send it without waiting for its answer (devtool-inbox send -NoWait), then run v47_ack. A picture 40 ticks ahead (v47_panel_armed: the label and 'Type /devtool checkpoint ack'), then arm V47_ARM_ACK 1200. Expect AWAIT condition=checkpoint outcome=satisfied with latencyTicks once v47_ack has run, and V47_ARM_ACKED.

v47_ack.description: Acknowledges what is armed or cued, as the bound operator, then pictures the screen (v47_panel_acked: no panel). Expect CHECKPOINT action=ack with latencyTicks and answered=arm (after v47_panel_arm_wait), and V47_ACK_END.

v47_cue_old.description: A cue for a client older than 1.9.0 (isolated old-client session: a 1.9.0 server, a 1.8.0 client). Default form. Expect CHECKPOINT action=cue form=actionbar, and the picture v47_old_cue (no hide, which 1.8.0 reads) showing the label in the action bar above the hotbar. Then ack. Ends with V47_CUE_OLD_END.

v47_old_sample_items.description: Items for a sample of 1.8.0 steps on a client older than 1.9.0 (isolated old-client session: a 1.9.0 server, a 1.8.0 client), run through the server's inbox so the caller is the inbox operator. Server commands only: the caller at 0.5 100 0.5 facing south, its inventory cleared, stone 8 in hotbar slot 0 (for client tooltip 0), a shield in hotbar slot 1 (for client select 1, client use, client hold use 10 and client drop). Expect V47_OLD_SAMPLE_READY.

v47_strict_setup.description: A fixture in a chunk that is then unloaded. The caller goes to 2000.5 101 2000.5, waits for the chunks, a pig v47far (no AI, tagged v47_fx and v47_far) is summoned and claimed as handle far, the caller comes back to the scene, and 200 ticks later fixture list reports it. Expect FIXTURE action=claim handle=far, then FIXTURE action=list state=unloaded (its chunk is beyond the view distance and was unloaded). Ends with V47_STRICT_READY.

v47_strict_clear.description: The strict clear stops a bundle (1.9.0). fixture clear all strict with the fixture far unloaded, then a summon that must not run. Expect FIXTURE action=clear handle=far outcome=notLoaded, the command failing devtool.fixture.notLoaded, BUNDLE_END executed=1 failed=1 stoppedEarly=true, no v47strict pig (checked by v47_strict_check).

v47_strict_check.description: After v47_strict_clear: no v47strict pig at the scene (ASSERT count 0 pass), and the handle kept (FIXTURE action=list handle=far state=unloaded). Then the same clear without strict: FIXTURE outcome=notLoaded and the command succeeds. Ends with V47_STRICT_CHECKED.
commands: devtool assert entities count 0 within 32 type minecraft:pig name v47strict

v47_strict_cleanup.description: Removes the far fixture where it is: goes there, waits for the chunks, clears it (FIXTURE outcome=removed handle=far), comes back. Ends with V47_STRICT_CLEANED.

v47_hint_nosession.description: Loud on purpose (quiet false), so the chat reply is also checked; the failure's ERROR record and the inbox run answer carry the step too. No session, then ${operator.name}. Expect outcome failed with firstFailure devtool.placeholder.unbound (the key unchanged), the answer's detail and the ERROR record's detail both "devtool.placeholder.unbound: run devtool session start <name> first", and a [CHAT] line naming devtool session start <name>.

v47_hint_nooperator.description: Loud on purpose (quiet false), so the chat reply is also checked; the failure's ERROR record and the inbox run answer carry the step too. A session with no operator, then ${operator.name}. Expect firstFailure devtool.placeholder.unbound, the answer's detail and the ERROR record's detail both "devtool.placeholder.unbound: run devtool session operator <player> first", and a [CHAT] line naming devtool session operator <player>.

v47_hint_nohandle.description: Loud on purpose (quiet false), so the chat reply is also checked; the failure's ERROR record and the inbox run answer carry the step too. A session and an operator, then ${fixture.nothere.uuid}. Expect firstFailure devtool.placeholder.unbound, the answer's detail and the ERROR record's detail both "devtool.placeholder.unbound: run devtool fixture claim nothere <selector|uuid|entityId> first", and a [CHAT] line naming the same claim.

v47_hint_fixture.description: Loud on purpose (quiet false), as the other hint cards. No session, then fixture list, which is no placeholder: expect outcome failed with a firstFailure (the command's message) naming devtool session start <name>, and no detail in the answer.

v47_await_far.description: An await chunks timeout names the view distance (1.9.0). Waits 40 ticks for chunks 6000 blocks away, which nobody loads (tolerated devtool.wait.timeout). Expect AWAIT condition=chunks outcome=timedOut with viewDistance (the client's render distance in single player: 12 on the development client, 6 on the isolated runtime). Ends with V47_AWAIT_FAR_END.

v47_book.description: A written book opened in single player (1.9.0 paused close). Puts a written book in hotbar slot 4, selects it, looks up, uses it: the book screen opens and pauses the game. Expect CLIENT_ACTION step=use done and, while the book is open, config/devtool/inbox/paused.json with screen=net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiScreenBook. Nothing after the use runs until the book closes, so the use is last.

v47_hold_die.description: A hold ended by death (1.9.0). Survival, client key key.forward hold 200, kill 20 ticks in. Expect the hold done released=died with heldTicks about 20; then the card's client respawn and v47_after_hold. Ends with V47_HOLD_DIE_END.

v47_hold_leave.description: A hold ended by leaving (1.9.0). client key key.forward hold 200, then 20 ticks later client reconnect 2 (last). Expect the client's own record of the hold done released=left (it cannot report), and the reconnect back; then v47_after_hold.

v47_after_hold.description: Nothing stays pressed after a hold ended by death or leaving: creative, two PLAYER_INSPECT 40 ticks apart with the same position. Ends with V47_AFTER_HOLD_END.

v47_heavy.description: A heavy world tick for the logout loop, bounded: a glass pen at x 18 to 43, z 18 to 39 (floor y 99) about 30 blocks from the scene, with 300 pigs with AI (named v47heavy, tagged v47_heavy, persistent, silent) pathing in it, all in loaded chunks; the caller back at the scene start. Rerunnable (kills the earlier ones first, with mob loot off). Expect ASSERT count 300 pass and V47_HEAVY_READY.

commands.command: devtool assert entities count 300 within 24 type minecraft:pig name v47heavy

v47_heavy_clear.description: Removes the heavy scene: mob loot off, kill @e[tag=v47_heavy], items and orbs removed inside the pen, mob loot back on. Expect V47_HEAVY_CLEARED.

v47_spartan_bash.description: Spartan Shields' bash by an input event (1.9.0, compatibility profile). An iron shield (spartanshields:shield_basic_iron) in hotbar slot 0; a pig v47bash with AI, slowed so it stays put, 2 blocks ahead; client hold use 40 (the shield raised), then 10 ticks later client attack route=event keepHold=true. Expect the attack's record route=event with taken=true (read during the input event), the use hold done released=done heldTicks=40, and the bash's effect: the pig's position moved between the two ENTITY_INSPECT records (knockback) and/or ENTITY_DAMAGE on v47bash. Ends with V47_BASH_END. The shield is raised 25 ticks after the teleport: a teleport to the spot the client last reported leaves the server reading the caller as in the air for up to 20 ticks, which a bash may check.

v47_rlcombat.description: RLCombat's attack by the mouse queue (1.9.0, compatibility profile). A diamond longsword (spartanweaponry:longsword_diamond) in hotbar slot 0; a zombie v47rl (no AI, helmet) 2 blocks ahead; client attack (route binding) then 25 ticks later client attack route=queue. Expect the queue click's record route=queue (or refused routeUnavailable with detail on Cleanroom) and ENTITY_DAMAGE on v47rl after it; the binding click recorded for comparison (RLCombat replaces the vanilla click; observed either way). Then client hold use 40 with a shield in the off hand and a queued attack 10 ticks in: RLCombat ignores a click while a hand is active (expect no ENTITY_DAMAGE from it). Ends with V47_RL_END. The first attack waits 21 ticks after the teleport: a teleport to the spot the client last reported leaves the server reading the caller as in the air for up to 20 ticks, which changes an attack (no sweep, no critical hit).

v47_spartan_bash_binding.description: The control for v47_spartan_bash (1.9.0, compatibility profile): the same raised-shield scene with the attack by the binding route, which posts no input event. An iron shield (spartanshields:shield_basic_iron) in hotbar slot 0; a pig v47bash with AI, slowed so it stays put, 2 blocks ahead; client hold use 40 (the shield raised), then 10 ticks later client attack route=binding keepHold=true. The press is counted on the attack binding as on the event route, and vanilla drains it while a hand is active; only Forge's InputEvent.MouseInputEvent is missing. Expect the attack's record route=binding (with taken), the use hold done released=done heldTicks=40, no ENTITY_DAMAGE on v47bash and the pig's position equal between the two ENTITY_INSPECT records (posZ 2.50: no bash). Run before or after v47_spartan_bash in the same session; the bash there pushes the pig about 4 blocks. Ends with V47_BASH_BINDING_END. The shield is raised 25 ticks after the teleport, as in v47_spartan_bash.

v47_rlcombat_web.description: RLCombat's own attack path told apart from vanilla's (1.9.0; compatibility profile, or the development client with RLCombat, FermiumBooter and ReachFix). A diamond sword (vanilla) in hotbar slot 0; a cobweb at 0 101 1, in the line of sight; a zombie v47rl (no AI, helmet) 2 blocks ahead, behind the web. A cobweb has a selection box but no collision box. Vanilla's pick (and ReachFix's replacement of it, which ray traces blocks the same way) stops at the web, so a vanilla click hits the web; a creative player with a sword cannot break it, and no attack reaches the zombie. RLCombat's click, which runs only from Forge's MouseEvent, ray traces past blocks without a collision box ('Swing Through Passable Blocks', default true), finds the zombie, cancels the MouseEvent and sends its own attack packet. client attack (route=binding: no MouseEvent), then 25 ticks later client attack route=queue (a real button press: Forge posts the MouseEvent). Expect: after the binding click no ENTITY_DAMAGE on v47rl and its health 20.00; after the queued click ENTITY_DAMAGE on v47rl and a lower health; BLOCK_INSPECT minecraft:web at 0 101 1 after each click. The two clicks differ only if RLCombat's MouseEvent path ran; equal results (both without damage) mean it did not. Ends with V47_RL_WEB_END. The first click waits more than 21 ticks after the teleport.

v47_rlcombat_offhand.description: RLCombat's offhand attack, which only its MouseEvent path makes (1.9.0; compatibility profile, or the development client with RLCombat, FermiumBooter and ReachFix). An empty main hand (hotbar slot 0 selected, empty), an iron sword (vanilla) in the off hand, a zombie v47rl (no AI, helmet) 2 blocks ahead. RLCombat attacks with the off-hand weapon on a right click read from Forge's MouseEvent ('Enable Offhand Attack', default true; ItemSword is in its default off-hand list); vanilla's right click on a zombie with an empty hand and a sword does nothing to it. client use (route=binding), 25 ticks later client use route=event (Forge's MouseInputEvent only, not the MouseEvent), 25 ticks later client use route=queue (a real right button press: Forge posts the MouseEvent). Expect no ENTITY_DAMAGE on v47rl and health 20.00 after the first two, and ENTITY_DAMAGE on v47rl (an off-hand hit, weaker by RLCombat's 'Offhand Efficiency') with a lower health after the queued one. The clicks differ only if RLCombat's MouseEvent path ran. Ends with V47_RL_OFF_END. The first click waits more than 21 ticks after the teleport.

v47_sort_chest_open.description: A chest in disorder for Inventory Tweaks' sort button (compatibility profile): dirt 5 in slot 0, stone 3 in slot 4, dirt 7 in slot 9, stone 2 in slot 13, opened by the caller, then client screen. Expect SCREEN_BUTTON records for Inventory Tweaks' buttons on the chest screen (labels s, h, v and ...). Ends with V47_SORT_OPEN.

v47_sort_check.description: After the sort button: the chest as the server keeps it (expect the dirt merged into one stack of 12 and the stone into one of 5, in the first slots), then client close. Ends with V47_SORT_CHECKED.

v47_hwyla_key.description: A mod's own key binding through both routes (compatibility profile, Hwyla 1.8.26, which reads its configuration key only in its KeyInputEvent listener). First client key waila.keybind.wailaconfig press on the default route: expect CLIENT_ACTION step=key binding=waila.keybind.wailaconfig route=binding result=done and client screen with no screen (screen=none), since the default route posts no KeyInputEvent. Then the mark V47_HWYLA_KEY_END and, last, the same press with route=queue: expect route=queue result=done with pressedTick and releasedTick and screen=mcp.mobius.waila.gui.screens.config.ScreenConfig in that record (the screen open when the press was let go, in the tick the game read the key). Hwyla's configuration screen pauses single player (it does not say otherwise), so nothing after the press would run: the press is last, the pause note config/devtool/inbox/paused.json names the screen while it is open, and the client request channel's close mcp.mobius.waila.gui.screens.config.ScreenConfig closes it. A refusal routeUnavailable with detail, or failed notCounted with countedOn, is recorded as it stands. The default press leaves one counted press unused on the binding, which the queued press's event also takes; the queued record is what shows the event came through the queue.
commands: devtool client key waila.keybind.wailaconfig press route=queue

v47_q_place.description: Question save, part 1 (the development client with a copy of Uppers 0.0.6 in run/mods): places an uppers:upper block on a stone block at 0 100 3 and saves (rerunnable: the block is cleared first, and a clear or stone that changes nothing is tolerated). Expect BLOCK_INSPECT block=uppers:upper at 0 100 3 and SAVE. Ends with V47_Q_PLACED.

v47_q_check.description: Question save, part 2 (the development client after Uppers was taken out of run/mods, after open ... onQuestion=confirm): where the missing block was. Forge keeps a missing block as an invisible stand-in that acts as air but keeps its old name (GameData's BlockDummyAir), so it reads as its old id, without its tile entity data. Expect BLOCK_INSPECT at 0 100 3 with block=uppers:upper and no tile entity, and V47_Q_CHECKED.

v47_cleanup.description: Returns the world to a neutral state without ending the session: logging off, no open screen, the scene fixtures and the heavy pigs removed (mob loot off meanwhile), items and orbs removed inside the scene and the pen (x -8 to 46, y 90 to 115, z -6 to 42), the sidebar objective removed, effects cleared, creative, back at the start. Every step may find nothing. Expect V47_CLEANED.
